ops.title: Host must not crash-loop on unsupported worker-record schema after upgrade
ops.description: 12.11.0→12.14.0: the new capt-hookd refused ~/Library/Caches/captain-hook/host-v1/workers.json ('keyed store bucket "stop-consumed" is missing', surfaced via daemonkit reactivation) and crash-looped, so every client timed out on start.lock and ALL hook dispatch failed machine-wide until the store was manually archived. On an unsupported/legacy record schema the host should archive the store aside (after best-effort reaping) and start fresh, not refuse to boot. Reproducer artifact: workers.json.12.11.0-schema.bak in the host-v1 cache dir. Related: 'build!: pin daemonkit v0.10.0' (4a9ca79) on main.

ops.text: A host started against a workers store with an unknown/legacy schema archives it and activates cleanly (test with the .bak artifact)
Old-store archival is logged loudly once, not retried in a loop
